incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert P-34912 fired for service=redwood-inference-serving severity=high — reason=Node GPU node-17 Unreachable (kernel panic / kubelet NotReady). Paging oncall: @oncall-anna

oncall-anna: acked oncall, looking now. can someone grab console access to node-17?

sre-james: I have console access via cloud-serial. pulling dmesg and last logs. brb.

pagerduty: Incident P-34912 acknowledged by oncall-anna at 1750001240 UTC. Escalation halted.

infra-maria: seeing repeated kernel oops followed by reboot loop on node-17 in serial logs. suspect GPU driver panic. snippet:
```
[1234567.891] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 79, pid=4321, GPU has fallen off the bus
[1234567.892] Kernel panic - not syncing: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference
```

oncall-anna: thanks. are pods on that node critical? which customers impacted?

eng-ryan: node-17 hosts 4 inference replicas for model/redwood-4b-quant, mostly prod-customer A (10% traffic) and some background batch jobs. traffic should failover but we have had a small latency uptick.

support-lee: support tickets: customer-a edge nodes reporting 503s around 09:12-09:18 — correlates. notifying customer success.

sre-james: trying to mark node unschedulable to prevent new pods: `kubectl cordon node-17` -> reported NotReady, but cordon still works. I'll drain what I can once node becomes reachable.

oncall-anna: do we have alternative capacity? can routing move requests instantly?

eng-ryan: Auto-routing is enabled. Requests should route to other nodes in pool but we saw a small backlog due to in-flight KV cache loss. Redis-backed cache should repopulate; latency spike expected for ~1-2 minutes.

infra-maria: requesting a soft reboot from host manager to clear GPU state. initiating `host-reboot node-17 --soft` now.

incident-bot: host-manager: reboot command accepted for node-17, expected downtime ~2 minutes.

sre-james: while rebooting, let's pre-scale other nodes to absorb load: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-quad --replicas=20 -n serving` bumped replicas by +3. monitoring.

oncall-anna: I’ll watch ingress error rates and customer impact dashboard. @support-lee update CS to tell customer A we are mitigating, brief partial impact, ETA ~5-10m.

support-lee: sent update to customer A: "We're investigating increased 503s for some requests; mitigation in progress. Will update in 5 minutes."

infra-maria: host reboot finished per host-manager. Serial shows node booted to linux but nvidia driver failing to load, kernel still unstable. attaching last few lines:
```
[    5.678901] nvidia: loading driver version 515.105.01
[    6.001234] NVRM: The GPU HZ timeout has been reached. GPU lockup?
[    6.001567] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
```

oncall-anna: kernel panic persists. we need to evacuate workloads off node-17 and mark it for maintenance to prevent further flapping. If kubelet not ready, draining won't finish; we should cordon and remove from load balancer.

sre-james: agreed. removing node from routing: `infra-cli lb detach-node node-17` -> done. also `kubectl delete node node-17` to let controller recreate (if autoscaling creates replacement). executing now.

eng-ryan: confirmed controller spun up replacement node-21 with GPU profile; pods are coming up there. Traffic routing back to healthy nodes.

pagerduty: Escalation note: oncall-anna -> incident stabilized. Incident P-34912 status: mitigated (routing/workload moved). Resolved? pending maintenance ticket.

oncall-anna: I will keep this thread open until we open infra ticket to repro and replace hardware. Creating maintenance ticket: INFRA-7624 (node-17 GPU hw failure). Assigning to infra-maria.

infra-maria: got it. will schedule NIC/PCI riser check and RMA GPU if hardware confirmed. tagging hw vendor.

support-lee: CS updated customer A: "Mitigation complete, traffic redirected, we expect no further impact. Postmortem will follow."

sre-james: note — add a follow-up to add node health probes earlier in admission to avoid assigning critical replicas to single node.

oncall-anna: thanks everyone. summary for incident channel to paste into incident system:
- Trigger: PagerDuty P-34912 fired due to kernel panic on GPU node-17 (NVRM Xid 79).
- Impact: ~10% of prod-customer A requests saw 503s for ~6 minutes; minor latency spike globally.
- Mitigation: Node removed from LB, replacement node spun up, pods rescheduled, host flagged for maintenance.
- Next steps: INFRA-7624 for hardware RMA, SRE to add admission constraint + improved probe.

pagerduty: Incident P-34912 marked mitigated by oncall-anna at 1750001630 UTC.

oncall-anna: resolving thread here; if anybody sees regressions ping this thread or reopen PagerDuty. :white_check_mark:
